title: Welcome to The NomWall — The Decentralized Community Hub
content: We built NomVerse without external social media dependencies (no X, no Facebook). All discussions, technical proposals, game ideas, and lore happen right here on this public wall. Connect your Phantom, MetaMask, or Google account to participate. Remember: sensitive contents are strictly forbidden to keep this a safe, family-friendly builder commons!

replies.content: Love the direct on-site discussion. No algorithmic timelines or account bans, just open CC0 collaboration.
Testing verified Google reply on the wall!

title: Idea: Adding Rainbow Candies for 2x Score Multiplier
content: The current golden candy drop physics feel super crisp! What if we add an occasional rare 'Rainbow Solana Candy' that drops with hyper-bouncing physics and awards +2 points? I can submit a PR editing MainScene.ts if the community agrees.

replies.content: Huge yes! Maybe also give Nomster a rainbow glowing tween when he eats it.

title: Drafting Chapter 3: The Great Candy Halving
